latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "AI for Video Editing": upload raw video clips and describe your desired edits to get a 1080p MP4 ready to download.
- Automatically trims silences, adds transitions, inserts background music, and more—all in the cloud, no software needed.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads, up to 500MB; export in multiple formats including MP4, MOV, GIF, and more.
- Fast setup with anonymous token for free trial usage (100 credits, 7-day expiry); session management and credit checks included.
- Clear error handling, timeline previews, and flexible workflows: quick edit, batch processing, or iterative refinement.
- Built for content creators and social media users who want pro-quality edits in minutes.
